notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Loran.
description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and disacrding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Loran by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
When Loran enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning Lion's Eye Diamond to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Loran.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Repeat.
